_description: IRMAA surcharge fires in year 2 based on year 0's $250k pension (IRS 2-year lookback).
_rationale: Single filer, age 65, Florida (0% state), referenceYear 2026, lifeExpectancy 67 (3-year horizon). One-time $250k pension at age 65 sets year-0 MAGI to $250k. No spending; surplus reinvests to auto-Reinvestment account. Year 0 and 1 have no IRMAA (no 2-year-prior MAGI yet). Year 2 looks back to year 0: $250k MAGI on the single tier table (2024 base, inflation factor 1 since inflationRate=0) falls in tier 5 ($193k–$500k) → $458.50/mo × 12 = $5,502/yr per Medicare enrollee. Single filer = 1 enrollee → $5,502.
name: IRMAA Trigger
